/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c \"
import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_excel('field_visit_log.xlsx', header=None)
header=df.iloc[4].tolist()
data=df.iloc[5:].reset_index(drop=True)
data.columns=header
# Clean column names
data.columns=[str(c).strip() for c in data.columns]
print(data.columns.tolist())
# Normalise village names
def norm_village(v):
    if pd.isna(v): return ''
    s=str(v).strip()
    s=' '.join(s.split())
    return s.lower()
data['village_norm']=data['Village'].apply(norm_village)
# deduplicate Visit ID keeping first occurrence
# Ensure Visit ID column name is 'Visit ID'
print('Visit ID column:', data.columns[0])
# Drop rows where Visit ID is NaN
data=data[data['Visit ID'].notna()]
# Keep first occurrence
data_dedup=data.drop_duplicates(subset=['Visit ID'], keep='first')
# Sum
total = data_dedup['Women Reached'].astype(int).sum() + data_dedup['Men Reached'].astype(int).sum() + data_dedup['Children Reached'].astype(int).sum()
print('Rows total', len(data), 'dedup', len(data_dedup))
print('Total people', total)
\"
"
